businessRequirement.title: Mastercard credit financial purchase transaction processing

scenarios.title: Card Number Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria: System shall accept valid Mastercard credit card numbers only
scenarios.note: PAN presence covered; Luhn only for payment tokens; no Mastercard BIN-range or card-status BR.

scenarios.title: Expiry Date Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria: System shall validate card expiration date
validations: Expiry date not past current date
scenarios.note: Template cites Element 51; ATL105 carries card expiry in Element 12 (Card Discretionary Block Data). No 'not past current date' BR.

scenarios.title: Card Status Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria: Card must be active and eligible for purchase
scenarios.note: No card blocked/lost/stolen/expired status BR (issuer-side behaviour).

scenarios.title: Segment 130 EMV Card Sequence Number Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria:
EMV Card Sequence Number (Element 188), when populated, identifies the sequence number of the EMV card; Conditional, sourced Device
(ATL105 §12.20 · Segment 130 · Element 188 · emv-card-sequence-number)
scenarios.note: FR basis: keyword 'EMV Card Sequence Number'; TS status: REVIEW_REQUIRED

scenarios.title: Card Discretionary Block Data Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria:
For a manually entered card, Element 12 begins with expiration in MMYY format, including expired cards.
TransArmor processing includes expiration data in Element 12.
Accel and STAR e-commerce and one-time bill payments require expiration data in Element 12.
Expiration is optional for applicable Accel or STAR credentials-on-file transactions from May 1, 2025.
(ATL105 §13.2 · Segment 100 · Element 12 · card-discretionary-block-data)
validations: TC-SEG100-E12-MANUAL-EXPIRATION-MMYY: Positive - Segment 100 · Element 12 · card-discretionary-block-data (accountNumber='0000000000000000', cardDiscretionaryBlockData='1226', validateCardDiscretionaryBlockData='True')

TC-SEG100-E12-MANUAL-EXPIRATION-EXPIRED: Positive - Segment 100 · Element 12 · card-discretionary-block-data (accountNumber='0000000000000000', cardDiscretionaryBlockData='0120', validateCardDiscretionaryBlockData='True')

TC-SEG100-E12-MANUAL-EXPIRATION-MISSING: Negative - Segment 100 · Element 12 · card-discretionary-block-data (accountNumber='0000000000000000', cardDiscretionaryBlockData='', validateCardDiscretionaryBlockData='True')
scenarios.note: FR basis: keyword 'expiration'; keyword 'Expiration'; TS status: EXECUTION_READY

scenarios.title: Processing Code Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria: System shall identify purchase transaction correctly
scenarios.note: Template 'Processing Code 020' corresponds to ATL105 Element 78 Prompt Code (transaction type 0 + card type).

scenarios.title: Entry Mode Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria: System shall validate card entry method
validations: Swipe, EMV, Contactless, Manual Entry, E-Commerce values allowed
scenarios.note: Entry-method consistency and EMV Segment 130 covered; no allow-list BR for Swipe/Contactless/Manual/E-Commerce.

scenarios.title: Merchant Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria: Merchant must be eligible
scenarios.note: Terminal Identifier (Element 102) covered; no Merchant-active or MCC BR.

scenarios.title: Message Format Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria: ATL105 request must meet format requirements
scenarios.note: Template cites Element 55 = ATL105 Message Format Version Identifier.

scenarios.title: Segment Count Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria: Number of segments must match actual payload

scenarios.title: Standard Message Data Segment Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria: Segment 100 required

scenarios.title: Account Number Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria: Account number required
scenarios.note: Template cites Element 24; ATL105 Account Number is Element 2. No explicit numeric/no-delimiter/no-control-char BR.

scenarios.title: Segment 111 Mastercard UCAF DSRP Composition Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria:
MasterCard AAV cryptogram data shall use Segment 111 Table ID 36 (UCAF Data) while Token/DSRP cryptograms shall use Segment 123 Element 237 (TAVV); when both are present, the UCAF Security Level Code shall be '21' (Channel Encrypted).
(ATL105 §Appendix Y · Segment 111,123 · Element 237 · mastercard-ucaf-dsrp-composition)
validations: TC-SEG100-APPY-MASTERCARD: AAV in Table ID 36, TAVV/DSRP in Segment 123, Security Level Code '21' when both present
scenarios.note: FR basis: Mastercard-specific purchase BR (no template TS); TS status: REVIEW_REQUIRED

scenarios.title: Three D Secure ECI Cryptogram Brand Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria:
A 3-D Secure Authorization Response shall return the applicable ECI/Terminal Type value (25, 26, 27, 28, or 29) together with the card-brand cryptogram: Visa CAVV, MasterCard AAV, or Amex AEVV.
(ATL105 §Appendix Y · Segment FINANCIAL-RESPONSE · three-d-secure-eci-cryptogram-brand)
validations: TC-SEG100-APPY-RESPONSE: Valid ECI value with matching brand cryptogram
scenarios.note: FR basis: Mastercard-specific purchase BR (no template TS); TS status: REVIEW_REQUIRED

scenarios.title: Segment 123 Required for Tokenized Mastercard DSRP Visa TAVV Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria:
Segment 123 is required on all initial and recurring transactions involving tokenized data, and on transactions that include MasterCard Token/DSRP or Visa TAVV data
(ATL105 §12.19 · Segment 123 · required-for-tokenized-mastercard-dsrp-visa-tavv)
scenarios.note: FR basis: Mastercard-specific purchase BR (no template TS); TS status: REVIEW_REQUIRED

scenarios.title: Segment 123 TAVV vs UCAF DSRP AAV Split Validation
scenarios.acceptanceCriteria:
When both MasterCard DSRP cryptogram and SecureCode/Identity Check 3DS AAV are present in the same request, the AAV must be carried in Segment 111 Table ID 36 (UCAF) and the Token/DSRP cryptogram must be carried in Segment 123 Element 237 (TAVV) — the two fields are not interchangeable and both may be required simultaneously
(ATL105 §12.19,AppendixY · Segment 123,111 · Element 237 · tavv-vs-ucaf-dsrp-aav-split)
scenarios.note: FR basis: Mastercard-specific purchase BR (no template TS); TS status: REVIEW_REQUIRED
